mapper.select: SELECT provenance.cell_id, provenance.provenance_ref, provenance.support_type, provenance.current_citation_id, provenance.semantic_hash FROM diagram_cell_provenance provenance JOIN diagram ON diagram.id = provenance.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 WHERE provenance.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND provenance.canvas_version = #{canvasVersion}

SELECT provenance.cell_id, provenance.provenance_ref, provenance.support_type, provenance.current_citation_id, provenance.semantic_hash FROM diagram_cell_provenance provenance JOIN diagram ON diagram.id = provenance.diagram_id AND diagram.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND diagram.deleted = 0 WHERE provenance.provenance_ref = #{provenanceRef} ORDER BY provenance.canvas_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram_canvas_version (diagram_id, version, content_hash, canvas_xml, mutation_origin, created_by, run_id) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{plan.canvasVersion}, #{plan.contentHash}, #{plan.canvasXml}, 'MANUAL', #{plan.ownerKey}, NULL)

INSERT INTO diagram_cell_provenance (diagram_id, cell_id, canvas_version, provenance_ref, semantic_hash, support_type, current_citation_id) VALUES (#{plan.diagramId}, #{cellId}, #{plan.canvasVersion}, #{provenance.provenanceRef}, #{provenance.semanticHash}, #{provenance.supportType}, #{provenance.currentCitationId})

INSERT INTO diagram_source_pin (diagram_id, material_id, version_id, processing_revision_id, state, first_used_at, latest_citation_at) SELECT DISTINCT #{plan.diagramId}, version.material_id, evidence.version_id, evidence.revision_id, 'ACTIVE', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM source_citation anchor JOIN source_citation citation ON citation.diagram_id = anchor.diagram_id AND citation.cell_id = anchor.cell_id AND citation.canvas_version = anchor.canvas_version AND citation.owner_key = #{plan.ownerKey} JOIN citation_evidence evidence ON evidence.citation_id = citation.id JOIN material_version version ON version.id = evidence.version_id JOIN material ON material.id = version.material_id AND material.owner_key = #{plan.ownerKey} WHERE anchor.id = #{citationId} AND anchor.owner_key = #{plan.ownerKey} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'ACTIVE', latest_citation_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
